name: tender-kit
description: The buyer's kit that goes from an interoperability framework to a tender, for KP2, Building a Government Interoperability Framework, and KP3, Education Digital Public Infrastructure Roadmap: ten skills that choose the procurement vehicle, draw the country baseline, turn the framework into requirements, set the scope, design local participation, draft the request for proposals, its annexes and its traceability matrix, check the package and draft the buying unit's covering memorandum. Every example is set in Progressa.
